stable.notes: The session card tells you what happened. Every finished row used to print the literal word Finished, so two sessions forked off the same repo read as the same three tokens no matter how long you looked at them. A row now leads with what that session actually did. The card is wider too, because the sprite was deciding how much room the reading got: at the old width a finished title was 68pt, which is ten characters of the font it is set in. Point at a row and it opens up. The three paths off a row, open it in the platform, open the session view here, clear it, used to sit lit on every row spending 57pt of every line; they now share the fixed slot that carries the age and the workspace at rest, and cross over when the pointer arrives. Nothing changes size, so the card never jumps, and right-click reaches the same three. The outcome scrolls while you point at it so a long sentence can be read without the row growing, and only the row under the pointer moves. Search by meaning moved out of the toolbar to the end of the Messages search row, beside the search it governs. Pairs with server 6.41.0.

notice.title: One last Accessibility toggle
notice.body: This update changes how COS Control is signed so macOS keeps your Accessibility permission across future updates. macOS drops the old grant one final time: open System Settings, Privacy & Security, Accessibility, toggle COS Control off and on, then reopen COS Control. You will not need to do this again.
